_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fiber_reinforced#1. The shipped HGO deck with fibers pointed along the load, run at +10% and -10% stretch and at k1/c = 1 and 10. The two COMPRESSION runs give the identical final stress despite the tenfold change in k1, while the two TENSION runs differ — that invariance is the proof the fiber term is gated off below unit stretch, and it is what the fixture asserts, not the (trivial) tension-compression asymmetry. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF).
